method: Read rendered computed foreground and ancestor background colours, alpha composite solid backgrounds, and calculate sRGB relative-luminance contrast. Threshold 4.5:1 ordinary text, 3:1 large text; 3:1 sampled control boundaries. Samples are repeated text instances across states, not unique strings or an exhaustive compliance test.
limits: No actual screen-reader, zoom/mobile/orientation or enabled reduced-motion result.
Not an exhaustive hover, focus, validation, native-popup, graph/icon, placeholder or pseudo-element inventory.
Text inside rendered, laid-out elements is sampled even below the viewport; clipping, occlusion and modal backdrop blending are not independently resolved.
Complex opacity, background-image, filter or blend cases are flagged rather than assigned a pass.
Zero-width border values on borderless controls do not establish a visible boundary.
Keyboard QA answers remain technical records, not learner observations or competencies.
